## Example 3.2 · Simple interest comparison {#fm3-example-3-2-i .fm-slide }

Compare simple and compound growth over 3 years for $P=\$1500$ at 5% p.a.

(i) Find the simple interest and total amount after 3 years

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 8 · Example 3.2 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
$I=1500(0.05)(3)=225$, so the simple-interest total is \$1725. Keep this result for comparison with parts (ii)–(iii).
:::
